note: Hub ids, pinned revisions, licences and sizes were read from the model cards on 2026-11-16 (task L3 of the next-steps plan); `verified` stays false until the owner confirms each entry on the Windows PC (models.md 9.1). Before a real run the owner also reviews the licence for commercial use and redistribution of fine-tuned weights (models.md 6.1). `eval --candidates` and `train` skip entries whose `verified` is false unless --allow-unverified is given. All Qwen3.5 repositories are multimodal (`...ForConditionalGeneration`, with a vision tower) and are used text-only (models.md 6.2). Thinking is on by default for some Qwen3.5 sizes, so every entry passes `enable_thinking: false`; the Qwen3 `/think` and `/nothink` switches are not supported. `trainable: false` marks an untrained-only candidate: `eval` and `export` accept it, `train` refuses it, the lock records it. `kind: fallback` is never chosen by the smallest-first rules: it is used only when named (`--candidate`) or when every other candidate fails.
